errors.message: *args and **kwargs is not supported in Sudocode yet
errors.hint: *args and **kwargs are not in the Python subset yet. Use a list parameter instead.

notes: Sudocode's own 'not supported' behaviour (SH-18), not CPython's, so it is hand-specified and never run through the CPython oracle. Position convention: the first token of the unsupported construct (open question: logged in docs/review/QUESTIONS.md).
